[Claude · 22K views] Sales reps drown in administrative work, from digging through scattered documentation to answering customer emails late into the night. Jared Sires, GTM Product Manager, shares how he went from account executive with zero coding experience to building CLAFTS (Claude Drafts), an AI email assistant powered by the Claude API that drafts customer replies in his own voice, with Claude Code. 

Check out the full case study to learn more: www.claude.com/blog/how-anthropic-uses-claude-gtm-engineering

news_items.headline: Claude Can Now Build Its Own Harness... For Every Task
news_items.summary:
[Prompt Engineering · 20K views] In this video I explain why using one coding harness (like Claude Code/Codex) for all knowledge work breaks down as the context window fills, leading to agentic laziness, self-preferential bias, and goal drift. I show how dynamic workflows solve this by splitting work into clean contexts via a JavaScript workflow that can spawn agents, run them in parallel, and use pipelines, choose models, resume after interruption, and optionally isolate work trees.

Anthropic Blogpost: https://claude.com/blog
